name: Patricia Von Queenglass
original_name: パトリシア・フォン・クイーングラス
source:
A good-hearted, if foolish, girl who is Angelica's only friend. She teases Angelica to the point Angelica resorts to physical violence to shut her up. She and Angelica go back a long way, both of them refer to each other by their affectionate nicknames "Pattie" and "Angie".

[spoiler] She is Galahad's (from Silverio Trinity) niece. She first met Angelica at a party and resolved to break through her antisocial aura. She quickly realised Angelica was hiding something from her and spent years trying to discern what it was. Although she has yet to figure out what Angelica is hiding, her efforts have given her perception which is more than effective against most people.

Her powers manipulate gravity. Although she excels in range and persistence, her powers are poor in terms of enchantment and interference. Because of this, she is also affected when she activates her powers. To overcome this, her custom-made rifle fires bullets which serve as a medium to channel her powers at the point of impact.  [/spoiler]
